question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank and complete the meaning of the sentence.

Most of the ministers are concerned with the _________ of office than the service of man.
solution:
The correct answer is **'loaves and fishes'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This idiom refers to material gain or profit, often associated with self-interest or greed, rather than altruistic service.
 
• The idiom **'loaves and fishes' **means materialist wealth.(भौतिकवादी धन)
 
 
• **Example**- Now a day everybody is interested only in the loaves and fishes of their jobs.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct idiom is** 'Loaves and fishes'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Leaps and bounds'**- refers to rapid progress or advancement(तीव्र प्रगति या उन्नति). while it could be relevant in certain contexts, it doesn't convey the idea of prioritizing material gain over service.
 
• **'Wear and tear'**- refers to the damage that occurs to something over time as a result of ordinary use.(सामान्य उपयोग के परिणामस्वरूप समय के साथ किसी चीज़ को होने वाली क्षति)
 
• **'Herculean task'**- refers to a task requiring immense efforts or strength. (अत्यधिक प्रयास या शक्ति की आवश्यकता वाला कार्य।)
